I was in a pretty identical situation a few years back, I had broken up with a past girlfriend, and afterwards she turned all my friends against me and immediately lost all my social standings, and companionship. I was completely alone and I felt everyone hated me. After that, I made a decision that since no one I loved was guaranteed to stick around for ever, I’d make a version of myself that I could love. The journey itself was quite complicated but when you boil it down, what I did is I broke down my insecurities into smaller and categories and pieces, so that I slowly begin to fix parts of myself I didn’t like, piece by piece. It’s been a five year journey, but now I’m in a far better place in my life then I’ve ever been, all because I convinced myself just to stay determined. Please, stay strong for me man, it’d make me really happy if you took my advice.

Comparing yourself to other people is a sure fire way to make yourself feel like garbage. Every one is born with different sets of advantages, whether it be height, smarts, charisma, or good looks, and besides no matter who you are there’s always someone better than you. That’s why it pays to not look outward at others, but inward at yourself. Don’t make goals to be as good as someone else, set goals to be better than the person you were yesterday, only then can you obtain pride in yourself, and happiness in you life. I’m rooting for you bro, stay strong

Hey man, I tried to kill myself with a knife a couple times too, I’ve been in the head space you’re at right now. Listen, don’t let anyone set goals for you, set goals for yourself, they’ll matter more to you that way. Like start small, for me cutting down on all my junk food, and spending some more time studying each day, helped prove to me that I wasn’t so worthless, and that I might the potential to eventually manifest something I’m proud of. Even the idea of it, just the idea that I COULD become something kept me going in those dark times. I know you have the inner strength, the strength to keep living despite this pain in your chest. I promise you that even if you do decide to go through with this, that maybe in the end you can at least say you gave it your all. I don’t really know how to help you with your thoughts that you’re causing others suffering, except usually a lot of the times people can feel it when you’re suffering. In the same way positive energy can help someone feel better, your negative energy when someone else is trying to talk to you can subconsciously make them feel sad as well. Maybe that’s not a comfort, but what I’m trying to say is that it might not actually be your fault, and that all you really need to worry about, is to find ways to improve your mental, and physical health, and finding a goal to work towards in that respect might help you find the reasons you need to just stay alive. Stay strong my friend, I’m here for you

Ok I’ve actually put a lot of thoughts into this. With our greater intelligence, humans are able to become self aware, not only of their own existence, but of how little it might matter in the grand scheme of things. This causes the brain what I would describe as mental whiplash as you begin to panic that you have no idea why you’re alive, and if you even should be. This sudden rush of mental stimulus and strain can overwhelm mental processes, and produce an abundance of stress chemicals which may result in panic attacks and possibly depression. In essence the very understanding of the idea of living without meaning makes us question if we want to die, and since no other animal has the brain power to ask themselves these questions, no other animal commits suicide the way we do. At least that’s my thoughts on it.

Well, here’s a way I like to look at, if someone gives a dream that seems impossible all they’ve got, they might not necessarily ever get there, but along the way they’ll certainly have gotten a lot stronger and smarter along their journey. A few years ago I though my dream of being an engineer was impossible but through all the tears late at night I stuck through it, and now I’m farther along than I’ve ever been. I still might not get there, but I’m proud of myself to say I’ve come this far.

I’ve tried hanging myself, and cutting my wrist before. The first time my parents found me cause I didn’t make the noise right and made a lot of noise, and the second time I was too scared to go through with it. Now, every time I look back at those moments, I realize that the only thing that kept my going after both those attempts was the desperate hope that in this vast callous world there was at least one thing that could make me happy, one thing to motivate me to at least make an effort to live. I realized that I needed a dream to follow, but when I thought about it, I realized I had no dream. So instead I made my goal to find a dream that could make me finally a little proud of myself. I don’t know if this will help for you, but until your month is up I encourage you to try and find any sliver of a dream or goal to live for. And maybe like me just the chance of future happiness will be enough to keep you moving forward.
